title: computer/reach/study can't reach an online desktop-app host (coderos-4080 stays Backoff/Unreachable)
body:
Found in shakeout round 2 (binary 38fbc3d0d9, macOS).

coderos-4080 runs the desktop host service (`com.openagents.desktop.host.service`); on coderos `openagents connect status` says "Online. Your phone can reach this computer." with an iroh endpoint and tailnet 100.74.238.61:47109. From the Mac, which is enrolled with it (`rights observe,operate,terminal,review,access_read`):

```
$ openagents computer list --wait 20
alias  label         link                             rights   route  host
-      coderos-4080  Backoff { until: Moment(2271) }  observe,…  -    93235bef…
$ openagents computer exec 93235bef --timeout 10 -- uname -a
openagents computer: 93235bef… did not connect within 15s (link Backoff { until: Moment(20845) }); pass --wait SECONDS to wait longer
$ openagents reach presence 93235bef
openagents reach: no presence sample for 93235bef… within 15s; the host may be offline or the relay unreachable
$ openagents reach probe 93235bef
loopback refused
… did not connect within 15s
$ openagents study status 93235bef ~/gym-efficiency   # same failure
```
`--json computer show` reports `last_failure: Unreachable`, `online: false`, `route: null`.

Expected: a host your phone reaches (iroh/tailnet) is reachable from `computer`, `reach` and `study` on an enrolled computer (same transports as the app), or the error says why (e.g. host doesn't publish presence on the relay; enable X) with a next step.
